title: Nobody can sign in on a release build unless the GitHub CLI is installed, and nothing says so
The handle menu's "Ask Ember…" never opens the ask box
Commands that change system settings run without asking: gsettings, dconf and defaults writes (a dead early return in classify.ts)
plat: Linux (RHEL 8 is the primary target), macOS

title: Classifier gaps let harmful commands run silently: cmake -E deletes, programs run through option values or stdin, path rules skipped for option-value destinations (Ember's own settings included), docker bind mounts, UNC paths (NTLM leak)
Announce-then-run trusts words it shouldn't: questions and hypotheticals count as "you asked for exactly this", and on Windows/macOS any audio playing through the speakers counts as the user's words
Ember's spoken announcement ends with "Say 'Ember, stop'", and its own microphone hearing that pulls the kill switch, stopping every task
Secrets can reach the model: seed/recovery phrases and "6-digit code" labels aren't recognised; the Windows/macOS host lacks Linux's guard for names that embed a secret field's value
Screenshots crash with a RangeError when a never-look window (password manager, RDP) sits left of the target window
Admin policy: a broken or too-new policy deletes every audit record older than 30 days; lockdown still connects to GitHub Copilot and drops BYOK and the never-look list; a BOM locks Ember down
Electron's default app menu ships: DevTools in every window, Ctrl+Q quits with no 'still working' question
A long unbroken token in command output freezes Ember for seconds to hours (quadratic redaction regex); output over 4 MiB re-copied per chunk

Windows safety rules have holes: never-run rules match only some display languages, the Explorer rule fails with hidden extensions (the default), and settings that weaken protection go through once the Settings app is allowed
Ember keeps listening for 'Hey Ember' and reading and speaking about the user's apps while the screen is locked

Data-folder failures: Ember exits silently when its data folder can't be written; a failed audit write leaves the task queue half-updated; failed saves are swallowed; a successful sign-in is lost if the token can't be saved

The targets runtime writes the shared bubble around its arbiter: the Connect offer is overwritten, timers blank other bubbles, "Lost build-01 [Reconnect]" becomes "Stopped." and Ember silently works on this PC
The command window traps keyboard focus, hides output from screen readers, doesn't focus the terminal for typed answers, hides password prompts, and pushes Allow / Not now below the fold

Consent and prompt windows: a fixed 440x300 window shows half the text, Connect works after 0.9 s, the prompt window never gets the keyboard on macOS/Windows, and Ember's bubble can cover approval windows
Text gets cut off or vanishes: short answers clipped at six lines with no 'Read all'; connection failures (host key changed included) vanish after 14 s
No support for Windows High Contrast (forced colours): switches, slider, focus rings, button edges and state symbols disappear
Computer names: short names and 'in Ubuntu' for Ubuntu-22.04 don't resolve (tasks run on this PC), the same computer can be added twice, and hyphenated folder or branch names are taken for computers

First run: Start ignores the setup check; on a Mac fixing one row hides the rest; missing Screen Recording is reported as 'window is off screen'; README leaves Windows users stuck at Smart App Control
Copilot connection errors: transient 5xx/429/timeouts shown raw and never retried; after a token rejection Ember still says Ready; a bad GITHUB_TOKEN silently overrides a working gh login
Typing on non-default setups: Caps-as-Ctrl remap breaks the shortcut; GNOME Typing Assist corrupts keys; Ctrl+1 becomes Ctrl+Shift+1 on AZERTY; left-handed mouse turns clicks into right clicks
Windows UI Automation walks off-screen content: long scrolled pages read as empty and screenshots of big pages are refused
Commands ask far too often: almost every real script asks with vague words; ordinary output flags the task as 'looks like instructions'; read-only aws/terraform/kubectl ask 'Changes AWS.'
Settings navigation: 'Bring Ember to a computer…' opens Settings behind the user's app and not at Computers
The status pill sits top-centre over the control Ember is clicking (address bar, ribbon)
'What Ember did' leaves out commands, SSH and WSL, and shows model-facing fragments
Keyboard and screen-reader gaps: no keyboard route when the shortcut is taken, 'On <computer>' is visual only, the mic consent text isn't read, bubble actions are mouse-only
The mixed-script marker underlines a non-Latin user's own folders on every card
